mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce berberine bioavailability, while berberine may inhibit CYP2C19 metabolism of eslicarbazepine's active metabolite, potentially affecting anticonvulsant efficacy.
action: Monitor anticonvulsant efficacy closely; consider alternative to berberine or dose adjustment of eslicarbazepine; counsel patient on consistent use of both agents.
